Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.

retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 10 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge. The English article, at revision 1375917408, argues the protocol out of the 1985 Vienna Convention for the protection of the ozone layer and compares it to the Kyoto Protocol; this atlas holds neither, and the two Vienna conventions it does hold — on diplomatic relations and on the law of treaties — are different treaties with the same city in their names. It is the same hole the Paris Agreement was retracted into in M40b: the atlas holds no climate or environmental record at all.
